詞／曲：Ben Fielding & Brooke Ligertwood
中文翻譯：Hillsong Official Translation

lines.b: You were the Word at the beginning
One with God the Load Most High
Your hidden glory in creation
Now revealed in You our Christ
What a beautiful name it is
What a beautiful name it is
The name of Jesus Christ my King
What a beautiful name it is
Nothing compares to this

lines.a: 這是何等榮美的名 耶穌的聖名
lines.b: What a beautiful name it is, the name of Jesus
You didn't want heaven without us
So Jesus, You brought heaven down

lines.a: 我罪雖重 但祢愛更深
lines.b: My sin was great, Your love was greater
What could separate us now
What a wonderful name it is
What a wonderful name it is
The name of Jesus Christ my King
What a wonderful name it is
Nothing compares to this

lines.a: 這是何等奇妙的名 耶穌的聖名
lines.b: What a wonderful name it is, the name of Jesus

lines.a: 這是何等奇妙的名 耶穌的聖名
lines.b: What a wonderful name it is, the name of Jesus

lines.a: 死困不住祢 幔子已挪去
lines.b: Death could not hold You, the veil tore before You
You silenced the boast of sin and grave

lines.a: 與天堂歡慶 祢榮耀顯明
lines.b: The heavens are roaring the praise of Your glory
For You are raised to life again

lines.a: 祢無所匹敵 祢無人相比
lines.b: You have no rival, You have no equal
Now and forever, God, You reign

lines.a: 國度屬於祢 榮耀屬於祢
lines.b: Yours is the Kingdom, Yours is the glory
Yours is the name above all names
What a powerful name it is
What a powerful name it is
The name of Jesus Christ my King
What a powerful name it is
Nothing can stand against

lines.a: 這是何等大能的名 耶穌的聖名
lines.b: What a powerful name it is, the name of Jesus

lines.b: You have no rival, You have no equal
